title: This Time I Will Find Happiness!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Louisa remembers three past lives in which her childhood friend and sweetheart became the hero, left to fight the demon lord, and never came back to her. When the latest hero, Graham, asks her to wait, she decides not to and sets out to find happiness on her own terms. A shoujo fantasy romance adapted from a web novel, with knights, mages and nobility.
life_message: A good life is one you choose for yourself instead of waiting on someone else's promise.
